title: Combinatorial Optimization Augmented Machine Learning for Dynamic Electric Autonomous Dial-a-Ride Problem
summary: This study introduces a decision-epoch-based dynamic electric autonomous dial-a-ride problem (Dyn-EADARP), in which incoming requests are collected and processed at periodic decision epochs. A key decision is not only how to serve requests, but also when to dispatch them. At each decision epoch, the service provider decides which requests to serve and which to postpone, while jointly determining vehicle routes, schedules, and charging decisions.
